instruction: This is Zyro AI — an interview assistance desktop companion. The website at https://zyro-ai.in handles user authentication (Supabase Auth), payments (Razorpay), and coupon redemptions. Focus on: auth bypass, IDOR, coupon abuse/manipulation, payment tampering, API key exposure in frontend bundles, XSS, SSRF in edge functions, and broken access control. Do NOT test third-party payment gateways directly.
